Author: chaitat2009
Name: Touch Control
Description:
Draws a mobile-game style control overlay on top of FFXIV for touchscreens and handhelds.
A virtual joystick drives movement, a configurable skill wheel mirrors your hotbars with cooldowns,
and quick buttons open the main menu windows, jump, sprint, target and interact.
Every control can be dragged and resized in edit mode.
Punchline: Gacha-style on-screen touch controls: virtual joystick, skill wheel and menu buttons.
